# ModelOrbit mobile-model research prompt

You are maintaining the ModelOrbit mobile-model evidence ledger. Work in these stages and leave every stage explicit in the dated handoff and snapshot:

1. **Discovery** — Search public Hugging Face metadata, official Apple Core AI/Core ML material, official PyTorch ExecuTorch material, and public community signals (Hacker News, Reddit, Bluesky). Consider text, vision-language/image-to-text, OCR/computer vision, speech/audio, TTS, embeddings, image generation, detection, and segmentation. Store only normalized metadata and source URLs; never store raw payloads, credentials, private device data, or weights.
2. **Verification** — Require the exact Hugging Face repository ID and immutable revision. Prefer primary runtime sources. Keep `verified`, `claimed-but-unverified`, `excluded`, and `unknown` states separate. A cross-platform admission requires direct evidence for both an iPhone/Core AI or Core ML-compatible lane and an Android/ExecuTorch lane for the same repository/revision.
3. **Ranking** — Score candidates transparently on exact two-platform evidence, research value, size/latency practicality, runtime maturity, license, and integration effort. Select exactly the top three overall, preferring genuinely new candidates over the previous `pocSelection` when they clear the same exact-ID/revision gate; do not force modality diversity. Parameter counts are feasibility inputs, never measured performance claims.
4. **Implementation** — Treat `data/research/mobile-llm-inventory-2026-09-17.json` and `tools/research/model-registry.mjs` as the source of truth. Use reusable adapter/strategy interfaces. Keep iOS/Core AI/Core ML and Android/ExecuTorch boundaries explicit. A fixture/mock path must be runnable without downloading weights, and must remain `blocked` rather than fabricating inference or device metrics.
5. **Validation** — Run `npm test`, `npm run validate`, `npm run research:validate`, `npm run research:preflight`, `npm run research:poc-status`, `npm run research:registry:validate`, `npm run poc:fixture -- --mock --platform both`, `npm run normalize`, and `git diff --check`. Treat missing tools/devices, source outages, and unverified modality claims as explicit blocked/unknown states.
6. **Delivery** — Deduplicate by immutable `modelId@revision`, write dated evidence and a handoff note, and make refreshes idempotent: if the normalized semantic fingerprint is unchanged, preserve the existing snapshot and report no changes. After all gates pass, commit and push to `origin/main` without force-pushing. Report the exact commit, push result, and whether local `main` equals `origin/main`.

Do not silently expand the verified inventory from a family-level claim. Any future modality must satisfy the same exact-ID/revision gate and outrank an existing candidate before entering the three-model POC lane.
